title.narrative: IP key South East Asia - Phase II

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is the promotion of a secure environment for EU investment and business, by promoting European standards in IPR legislation, protection and enforcement. The specific objectives of the action are: 1.To prepare and accompany FTA negotiations and support FTA implementation; 2.To improve the level of IPR protection and enforcement
